transactions.desc: The Twins reinstated Acton (shoulder) from the 60-day injured list Saturday and optioned him to Triple-A St. Paul, Dan Hayes of The Athletic reports.
The Twins optioned Matthews to Triple-A St. Paul on Saturday, Dan Hayes of The Athletic reports.
The Mets selected Herget's contract from Triple-A Syracuse on Saturday.
The Mets optioned Curry to Triple-A Syracuse on Saturday.
Atlanta designated Hernandez for assignment Saturday.
Atlanta recalled Karinchak from Triple-A Gwinnett on Saturday.
The Cardinals optioned Svanson to Triple-A Memphis on Saturday.
The Cardinals designated Hence for assignment Saturday.
The Cardinals selected Mathews' contract from Triple-A Memphis on Saturday.
The Cleveland Guardians traded C Bo Naylor to the Milwaukee Brewers.
The Milwaukee Brewers traded RHP Craig Yoho to the Cleveland Guardians.
The Cleveland Guardians traded RHP Codi Heuer to the Milwaukee Brewers.
The Milwaukee Brewers traded OF Blake Perkins to the Cleveland Guardians.
The Minnesota Twins traded OF Jhomnardo Reyes to the Baltimore Orioles.
The Baltimore Orioles traded RHP Dean Kremer to the Minnesota Twins.
The Dodgers designated McDermott for assignment Friday.
The Dodgers selected Irvin's contract from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Friday, Jack Harris of the California Post reports.
The Mariners recalled Rivas from Triple-A Tacoma on Friday.
The Tigers designated Granillo for assignment Friday.
The Tigers optioned Hanifee to Triple-A Toledo on Friday.
The Tigers recalled De Jesus from Triple-A Toledo on Friday.
The Tigers selected Clark's contract from Triple-A Toledo on Friday.
Cano agreed to a two-year, $7.5 milion contract extension with the Orioles on Friday.
The Athletics designated Zhuang for assignment Friday.
The Brewers designated Pannone for assignment Friday, Hunter Baumgardt of Fox Sports 920 Milwaukee reports.
The Athletics optioned Thomas to Triple-A Las Vegas on Friday.
The Brewers reinstated Hall (pectoral) from the injured list Friday, Hunter Baumgardt of Fox Sports 920 Milwaukee reports.
The Rockies reinstated Doyle (groin) from the 10-day injured list Friday.
The Astros re-signed Shewmake to a minor league deal and assigned him to Triple-A Sugar Land on Friday, Brian McTaggart of MLB.com reports.
The Rangers optioned Smith to Triple-A Round Rock on Friday.
